question: Will Dr Aline Mercier read Ravi Patel's thesis chapter and send comments before the faculty deadline on Friday? Ravi emailed the chapter to his supervisor on Monday morning. answer.explanation: No committed event shows that Dr Aline Mercier actually sent comments to Ravi Patel before the deadline; she only read parts of the chapter and replied promising to send comments.
